articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.snippet: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Trump to throw spotlight on overseas crypto abuses at White House event
articles.snippet: The president is hosting a cybercrime event that will highlight U.S. authorities' efforts to crack down on crypto scams run by foreign criminal organizations.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.snippet: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

articles.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
articles.snippet: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.
